description: NaNdTiO₄ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/nmm space group. Na is bonded to five equivalent O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaO₅ square pyramids. There is one shorter (2.33 Å) and four longer (2.66 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Nd is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Nd-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.71 Å. Ti is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.77-2.64 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five equivalent Nd and one Ti atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to five equivalent Na and one Ti atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Ti octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 6°. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Nd and two equivalent Ti atoms.
